Article (2)
 
Categories of Businesses or Business Activities Conducted by a Natural Person 
that are Subject to Corporate Tax
 
1. For the purposes of Clause (6) of Article (11) of the Corporate Tax Law, Businesses or 
Business Activities, conducted by a resident or non-resident natural person, shall be 
subject to Corporate Tax only where the total Turnover derived from such Businesses 

or Business Activities exceeds AED 1,000,000 (one million United Arab Emirates 
dirhams) within a Gregorian calendar year. 
2. Notwithstanding Clause (1) of this Article, activities that give rise to Turnover from the 
following sources shall not be considered as Businesses or Business Activities 
conducted by a resident or non-resident natural person subject to Corporate Tax, 
regardless of the amount of Turnover derived from such activities: 
a. Wage. 
b. Personal Investment income. 
c. Real Estate Investment income. 
3. The natural person that is not conducting a Business or Business Activities subject to 
Corporate Tax in accordance with this Article shall not be required to register for 
Corporate Tax.
note: Condition concerns gross business turnover, not a tax-free profit allowance. Wage, Personal Investment and Real Estate Investment categories are excluded subject to their Article 1 definitions (including licensing/commercial-business conditions). Corporate-tax tax-period application begins with calendar 2024, as clarified by the FTA natural-person guide section 6.3.
